what_this_is: The words and limits of services a person's own computer can connect or carry (read by src/carried-connections.mjs). A computer carries a service by publishing an agent card whose skills include `<skill_prefix><vendor>`; it can start setup when its skill includes `<connect_skill_prefix><vendor>`. The service itself is a service-connections descriptor with `carriedBy`. Each verb is one thing an AI can ask that computer to do: its job words ({service} and each field fill in), its fields (required, longest text, whole-number range), and `needs_one_of` when one of several fields must be given. Adding a verb, a limit or a sentence is a change here and nothing else.

status.job: Read the current {service} connection and local incoming-copy state

disconnect.job: Disconnect the named {service} account {account} from this computer; preserve pending items

revoke.job: Revoke this computer's linked {service} session for account {account} and verify the provider reply

read_incoming.job: Read selected account metadata for local {service} incoming copies

erase_incoming.job: Erase the explicitly selected local incoming journal copies for {service} account {account}

pause.job: Pause {service} on this computer until explicitly resumed

resume.job: Resume the already linked {service} on this computer

words.unknown_verb: There is no {verb} for messages; use one of: {verbs}.
words.unknown_service: {service} is not a service a computer can carry here. Services your computers carry now: {carried}.
words.not_carried: No computer carries {name} yet. If you can run programs on the person's computer, start Trillion's connection helper there yourself; leave only the required sign-in, permission or device-pairing step to them.
words.not_connectable: No awake Trillion helper can start {name} setup. If you can reach the person's computer, open Trillion there; otherwise explain that Trillion cannot start a helper on a computer it cannot reach.
words.away: {name} is reached through {computer}, which was last seen {seen}. Wake it and make sure the Trillion helper is running; nothing was sent.
words.not_whole: {field} is a whole number from {min} to {max}.
words.request_key: request_key is needed: any unique text, so the same message is never sent twice.
words.waiting: {computer} has the request and has not answered yet. Read it with read_handoff {handoff_id}.
